annotations.title: Add a place to send charts

description: Save a destination that charts can be sent to: 'slack', 'teams' or 'discord' (needs the channel's incoming webhook URL, which the user creates in that app), 'email' (the user's own confirmed address, no URL), or 'webhook' (any https URL; requests are signed). Nothing is sent yet; connect a chart to it with send_chart_on_update or schedule_chart. Returns the destination id. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).

type.description: Where to send: slack, teams, discord, email or webhook.

url.description: The incoming webhook URL (not for email).
